source: spec v3.3 (4bac8d6) sections 7.2, 9.1, 10 and the 6.5 fleet record table; action names are the L0 permission vocabulary

notes.coauthor.declare: 6.5 names an AC seat; L0 also lets the verification lane and security reviewer declare, since they are fleet principals that may contribute text (9.2 'every fleet principal')
notes.owner: 9.5: owner-record.confirm is signed by an AC seat or the scope seat, never the owner
notes.finding.open: 10 requires C2 to have no open security finding but names no record for it; L0 lets the security reviewer open and close findings (L0 choice, for the spec owner to confirm)
notes.served_by.attest: 9.1, 9.8 (Addendum C5): only the owner-assigned measurer attests; it never votes
